snippet.title: Crêpe Master! | Release Date Trailer | Meta Quest 3
snippet.description:
🌟 Link : https://www.meta.com/fr-fr/experiences/25996574736658734/ 
🌟 Crêpe Master is a VR beat them up where you play as Hana on a mission to save the sacred crêpe from an alien threat. Step into the role of a magical girl in a fun, wacky universe, and fight to protect the crêpe at all costs!
